info.name: CarRental API - Full Test Suite
info.description: اختبار متسلسل كامل لـ CarRental API. اضبط adminPassword ثم شغّل Run Collection. يتم حفظ adminToken وcustomerToken ومعرفات الموارد تلقائيًا في متغيرات المجموعة. المصادقة JWT، والسيارات تستخدم multipart/form-data، وحجوزات العميل تستخدم هوية JWT الخاصة به.

request.description: Operational health probe. No token required.
Issues the administrator JWT. Set adminPassword in collection variables before running.
Confirms the JWT identity and role.
Negative check for the protected admin identity endpoint.
Creates a customer account and returns a Customer JWT. The pre-request script generates a unique email per run.
Public catalogue of cars available for booking.
Admin-only multipart/form-data request. Image is optional; select a file in the image field when needed.
Admin-only multipart update. The status is explicitly restored to Available for the later booking tests.
Deletes a car with no rental history.

exec: pm.test('admin update name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Postman Customer Admin Updated'));

request.description: Customer-only booking. The customer identity is read from the JWT; customerId is intentionally not accepted in the body.

exec: pm.test('my rental is present', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(r => String(r.id) === id)).to.eql(true));

request.description: Admin-only booking. totalPrice and status are calculated by the server.
Only dates and optional status are accepted. totalPrice is recalculated by the server.
Deletes the test rental after completion.
